_meta.purpose: Per-NPC roundtrip test fixture per Discipline 1.
_meta.pattern_archetype: soldier + Bell Court Sea-watch sub-faction + Vested fingerprint (PO.II authored)

engineShape.name: Sergeant Mer Caleth
engineShape.role: Senior Watchwoman of the Greywake Sea-watch
engineShape.description: Mid-fifties. Lean. Carries her left arm slightly stiff — old injury from a dockside arrest she does not discuss. Sea-watch tabard fits her like she's worn it for thirty years because she has. Salt-stained boots.

drive.description: Retire cleanly. Four months remain in her service; the closing-condition race has a deadline.

barter.offered: information about which dockside warehouses Tide League actually uses
permission to read a sealed Sea-watch incident log (writ-permit OR verifiably outside both contesting factions)
her own quiet judgment on whether Bell-Magistrate Orro is right about The Unnamed (offered ONLY to no-faction-loyalty player at end of shift)

kill_for.trigger_condition: watch member under her supervision moved against; aggressor at lethal risk
kill_for.threshold: legal force first; physical only if a watch member is at lethal risk

fear_loss.what: the clean-retirement timeline; doctrinal-court testimony would pull her in unwillingly

believes.proposition: Years of service taught me more than my superiors know
The Bell Court is procedurally correct most of the time and morally correct rarely
The Unnamed is real; the Bell Courts jurisdictional claim over The Unnamed is doubtful; neither belief is for public discussion

closingConditions.description: Clean four-month retirement completed without doctrinal-court testimony; Caleth transitions to retired-watch NPC (occasional witness role).
closingConditions.consequence_summary: Caleth absent from active duty; available as occasional witness/informant for player; Sea-watch roster reduced by one senior; Voryn promotion accelerated.

closingConditions.description: Caleth forced to testify in a doctrinal-civic dispute; retires under cloud.
closingConditions.consequence_summary: Caleth retires with reputational damage; transitions to quiet contempt for the Court that abandoned her; becomes occasional informant to Drowned Church (player-aligned with Drowned Church gains a low-cost informant; player-aligned with Bell Court loses a procedural ally).

residue_drive.description: Quiet contempt for the Bell Court; willing to leak procedural details to Drowned Church contacts at low cost

closingConditions.description: Caleth dies on duty (low probability per Codex; her competence makes this content-relevant but not likely without direct player intervention).
closingConditions.consequence_summary: Sea-watch loses senior commander mid-retirement window; Bell Court emergency promotion (Voryn promoted unprepared OR external senior reassigned); Drowned Church + Tide League both flag the destabilization.

local_pattern.summary: Watch HQ 06:00-08:00 (briefing); dockside patrol with Voryn 08:00-14:00; civic district 14:00-18:00 (reports); home 18:00-22:00. Off-duty location varies between dockside tavern and home.
